modmenu.summaryTranslation.lava_boat_clu: Waxay hagaajisaa xeerka qabashada doontida lavada, u malaynayaa
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.lava_boat:
Waxay soo celisaa xeerka qabashada doontida lavada ee lagu hagaajiyay 1.21.5.

Marki ugu horraynta ee lavada la xiriirto, doontidu waxay helaysaa wakhti gaaban oo difaac ah si ciyaaryahanka ugu soo degi karo hitbox-keeda.

Hadda waad yeelan kartaa qabashada lavada sida Dream laakiin noocyada cusub!
